reason: I've paid for this exact dream two or three times and every time I drifted back to Apple Notes within a few months. The done/push/shrink/drop prompt sounds nice, but I'd probably poke at the free trial and never put a card in.
objection: The app was never the problem, I am. Another planner won't make me stick to blocks, and Google Calendar already lets me drag stuff around for free.
would_change_my_mind: If the free plan alone kept me using it daily for a month without me forcing it, and then the paid tier unlocked something I actually missed.
